events.name: Dayton's Holiday Market
events.description: Dayton’s Holiday Market returns for its 6th Glorious Year! Get an early start on your holiday shopping at this market with over 100 local makers, and grab a bite or beverage while you browse.

events.name: Art Attack
events.description: Art Attack, the Northrup King Building’s highly anticipated fall open studio event, showcases and celebrates four floors of amazing art from local artists. Meet the artists, find a treasure for your home, learn about the creative process with live art demos, immerse yourself in interactive art experiences, and grab a bite from the guest food trucks.

events.name: Brandi Carlile
events.description: Brandi Carlile is bringing her “Burn the Setlist (The All Request Tour)” to the State Theatre in downtown Minneapolis. The tour doesn't feature even one planned song and guarantees an intimate concert with the acclaimed singer-songwriter.

events.name: Maybe Happy Ending
events.description: Winner of 6 Tony Awards, including Best Musical, Maybe Happy Ending tells the deeply human story of a chance encounter that sparks connection, adventure and maybe even love. Helmed by Tony Award-winning director Michael Arden, the musical has been called “one of the best musicals in years.”

events.name: Twin Cities Con
events.description: Fans of all ages are invited to join the fun and meet dozens of internationally known TV and movie actors, wrestlers, anime voice actors, comic creators, and other entertainers at Twin Cities Con! Featuring celebrity appearances and special guests, vendors, discussion panels and more.

events.name: Minneapolis Christkindl Market
events.description: Start to get into the holiday spirit at the second annual Minneapolis Christkindl Market — an authentic German-style Christmas market in the heart of Minneapolis! Stroll through a sparkling outdoor wonderland of twinkling lights, alpine-style wooden huts, and the cozy aroma of mulled wine.

events.name: Minneapolis Vintage Market
events.description: The Minneapolis Vintage Market returns to Quincy Hall and features over 65 of Minnesota's best vintage clothing, accessories and home goods vendors all in one spot. There will also be coffee, a food vendor, a bar, and a DJ.

events.name: Turkey Day 5k
events.description: Start your Thanksgiving festivities strong with a 5K through Downtown Minneapolis! Turkey Day is for those who like to start the day with a casual gallop through the city and a shiny medal for their efforts.

events.name: Thanksgiving at the Dakota Jazz Club

events.name: How to Train Your Dragon in Concert with the Minnesota Orchestra
events.description: DreamWorks’ “How to Train Your Dragon” tells the story of a young Viking named Hiccup who befriends a ferocious dragon he calls Toothless. Featuring John Powell’s Oscar-nominated score performed live to picture, it is a thrilling experience for all ages.

events.name: Go to a Minnesota Timberwolves Game
